name: Elfeena ~Yoru e to Urareta Oukoku de...~
original_name: エルフィーナ～淫夜へと売られた王国で…～
source:
Elfina lived a life of luxury as a member of the royal family. She was waited on hand and foot and had a team of servants. That was until her country was invaded! Now Elfina must comply to the sexual demands of her new masters and it doesn't matter how humiliating or intimate the favors! 

[from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1626]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
艾尔菲娜身为王室成员，原本过着奢华生活，受到无微不至的服侍，还有一大群仆人。直到她的国家遭到入侵！如今，艾尔菲娜必须服从新主人提出的性要求，无论那些要求多么羞耻或亲密！

[摘自[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=1626]AniDB[/url]]
